nodes.label: Report: Real spending data beats Monzy's six questions
Decision: Aaj should build a spend-based card recommender
nodes.rationale: Aaj already measures real monthly spend by category, merchant and card, so it can compute the counterfactual rupee value of each card; Monzy's quiz uses 3 spend bands and cannot. Commission income is small (~Rs 6k-18k/yr per 1,000 MAU) and from 1 Jan 2027 binds Aaj to bank DSA conduct rules, so the value is retention and trust.

nodes.label: Missed-rewards report ('you left Rs X on the table')
nodes.rationale: First feature: needs no new card and no commission; works on India's ~124M existing cards while net additions are only ~0.9M/month.

nodes.label: Top-3 next-card ranking by gain over current best card
nodes.rationale: Rank by marginal gain over the user's current best setup, not absolute card quality; plain bank links first, commission links later if at all.

nodes.label: Net value / Score formula per card
Point value table per card and redemption route
nodes.rationale: Devaluations often hit redemption rather than earn rates (Infinia voucher cap, Atlas transfer partners).

nodes.label: Curated merchant-to-category mapping with confidence
nodes.rationale: SMS carries merchant names but not MCCs, and Axis uses internal categories.

nodes.label: Supabase cards table (JSON rules, verified_at, source URL)
MVP of 30-40 hand-built mass-market cards
nodes.rationale: Monzy's catalogue cannot be reused because its terms forbid scraping; build from bank T&C pages with monthly review plus April/July passes; GitHub Actions cron flags cards unverified >45 days.

nodes.label: Eligibility bands: likely / stretch / unlikely
nodes.rationale: Issuers publish income thresholds, not score cut-offs; never say 'pre-approved'.

nodes.label: Responsible-design guardrails (hide apply for stressed users, opt-in, 18+)
nodes.rationale: Guardrails matter more than the formula; outstanding card balances ~Rs 3.1 lakh crore (Mar 2026).

nodes.label: RBI Credit and Debit Cards Issuance and Conduct Directions 2025
RBI advertising, marketing and sale amendments (effective 1 Jan 2027)
Paid referrer treated as bank DSA/DMA
nodes.rationale: Definition covers anyone engaged to 'sell, market, promote or influence' regardless of contract name; a zero-commission recommender like Monzy sits outside the 'engaged by a bank' test.

nodes.label: Separate consent for using transactions to suggest cards
nodes.rationale: Card recommendation is a new purpose under DPDP, distinct from expense tracking.

nodes.label: 18% GST and s.194H TDS on referral commission
Vercel Hobby non-commercial limit
nodes.rationale: Affiliate links count as commercial use, so the API must move to a free host that allows commercial use (Cloudflare Workers or Oracle Always Free) before any commission link.

nodes.label: Affiliate commission economics (~Rs 1,500 per activated card)
Subscription alternative (Rs 49-99/month alerts)
nodes.rationale: Steadier than commissions and avoids conflicts; Indian willingness to pay unproven; Play Billing takes 15%.

nodes.label: Aaj 'we never sell you a loan' promise
nodes.rationale: Earlier roadmap advised against card referrals; commission-free recommendations keep the promise, so commission links stay optional and late.

hyperedges.label: Spend-based recommendation pipeline (card rules, merchant mapping and point values feed the net value formula for missed-rewards and next-card ranking)
